# Alert (`alert`)

Inline message: info, success, warning, error; dismissible.

Group: Feedback. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/feedback';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createAlert` (types in `dist/web/feedback/alert.d.ts`): `.mh-alert--info | --success | --warning | --danger`: an inline message with an icon, optional title, action and close button. Parts `__icon`, `__body`, `__title`, `__message`, `__action`, `__dismiss`.

```ts
export function createAlert(options: AlertOptions): AlertHandle;

export interface AlertOptions {
  message: string;
  tone?: AlertTone;
  title?: string;
  /** Replaces the tone's icon; `false` hides the icon. */
  icon?: IconName | string | false;
  /** An action at the end (a text button or link). */
  action?: HTMLElement;
  /** Shows a close button; `onDismiss` runs and the alert removes itself. */
  dismissible?: boolean;
  /** Label of the close button (default "Dismiss"). */
  dismissLabel?: string;
  onDismiss?: () => void;
}

export interface AlertHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  setMessage(message: string): void;
  setTitle(title: string | null): void;
  dismiss(): void;
}
```

`createButton` (types in `dist/web/actions/button.d.ts`): `.mh-button` with `--primary | --secondary | --tonal | --text | --danger` and `--sm | --lg`; states `.is-loading` and `:disabled`. Height follows the theme's density, corners its control radius.

```ts
export function createButton(options: ButtonOptions): ButtonHandle;

export interface ButtonOptions {
  label: string;
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  trailingIcon?: IconName | string;
  loading?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  type?: 'button' | 'submit' | 'reset';
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
}

export interface ButtonHandle {
  el: HTMLButtonElement;
  setLabel(label: string): void;
  setLoading(loading: boolean): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createAlert, createButton } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const retry = createButton({
  label: 'Retry',
  variant: 'secondary',
  size: 'small',
  onClick: () => {
    retry.setLoading(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      retry.setLoading(false);
      alert.setMessage('Still no reading. Check that the sensor has power.');
    }, 800);
  },
});

const alert = createAlert({
  tone: 'danger',
  title: 'Hallway sensor offline',
  message: 'No reading for 2 hours.',
  action: retry.el,
  dismissible: true,
});

document.body.append(alert.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Alert, Button } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function AlertExample() {
  const [checking, setChecking] = useState(false);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState('No reading for 2 hours.');
  const retry = () => {
    setChecking(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setChecking(false);
      setMessage('Still no reading. Check that the sensor has power.');
    }, 800);
  };
  return (
    <Alert
      tone="danger"
      title="Hallway sensor offline"
      dismissible
      action={
        <Button variant="secondary" size="small" loading={checking} onClick={retry}>
          Retry
        </Button>
      }
    >
      {message}
    </Alert>
  );
}
```
